name: Iglesias (Italy)
description: Horizontal bicolour of red and blue, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Iglesias (a red shield beneath three heads on blue) within branches, with the inscription CITTA' DI IGLESIAS in blue arched above.
history: Municipal flag of Iglesias, a comune in Sardinia; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Iglesias arms — red shield beneath three heads on blue, crowned, within branches
inscription CITTA' DI IGLESIAS arched above the arms
